records.context: The shared tuner of the OPS decode (``ops_decode_threshold_mode`` 'auto') and the spacer-prefix decode (``ops_prefix_threshold_tuning`` 'per_well_decoy'). Each axis is one threshold, spot detection or calling, with its values ordered from the loosest to the strictest; every combination is one grid setting. The microplate sample position's microscope fields of view with cells, in site order, are split at random (``numpy.random.default_rng(seed)``) into a tuning share and a report share, as :func:`choose_well_thresholds` splits them. Only the tuning share chooses, and only decoy calls are read, never a reference call set.
records.label: spacr.ops_decode.tune_thresholds#1
records.source: The shared tuner of the OPS decode (``ops_decode_threshold_mode`` 'auto') and the spacer-prefix decode (``ops_prefix_threshold_tuning`` 'per_well_decoy'). Each axis is one threshold, spot detection or calling, with its values ordered from the loosest to the strictest; every combination is one grid setting. The well's fields with cells, in site order, are split at random (``numpy.random.default_rng(seed)``) into a tuning share and a report share, as :func:`choose_well_thresholds` splits them. Only the tuning share chooses, and only decoy calls are read, never a reference call set.
records.translation: El ajustador compartido de la decodificación OPS (``ops_decode_threshold_mode`` 'auto') y de la decodificación de prefijos de espaciador (``ops_prefix_threshold_tuning`` 'per_well_decoy'). Cada eje es un umbral, de detección de puntos o de llamada, con sus valores ordenados del más laxo al más estricto; cada combinación es un ajuste de la cuadrícula. Los campos de visión del microscopio de la posición de muestra de la microplaca con células, en orden de sitio, se dividen al azar (``numpy.random.default_rng(seed)``) en una parte de ajuste y una parte de informe, como los divide :func:`choose_well_thresholds`. Solo la parte de ajuste elige, y solo se leen llamadas de señuelo, nunca un conjunto de llamadas de referencia.

records.context: With ``objective`` 'recall_at_fdr' a setting passes when its decoy FDR -- the upper end of the 95 % field-bootstrap interval with ``ci``, else the estimate; a share with no decoy call is judged as holding three -- is at most ``fdr_max``, and the passing setting with the most real calls wins. With none passing, ``unreachable`` 'lowest_fdr' takes the setting with the lowest such FDR (then the most real calls) and 'strictest' the last value of every axis; ``auto_met`` is then False. With 'f_score' the setting with the highest F-score of precision (one minus the FDR estimate) and recall (the genotyped share) wins. Ties go to the stricter setting, the later axes deciding last.
records.label: spacr.ops_decode.tune_thresholds#2
records.source: With ``objective`` 'recall_at_fdr' a setting passes when its decoy FDR -- the upper end of the 95 % field-bootstrap interval with ``ci``, else the estimate; a share with no decoy call is judged as holding three -- is at most ``fdr_max``, and the passing setting with the most real calls wins. With none passing, ``unreachable`` 'lowest_fdr' takes the setting with the lowest such FDR (then the most real calls) and 'strictest' the last value of every axis; ``auto_met`` is then False. With 'f_score' the setting with the highest F-score of precision (one minus the FDR estimate) and recall (the genotyped share) wins. Ties go to the stricter setting, the later axes deciding last.
records.translation: Con ``objective`` 'recall_at_fdr' un ajuste pasa cuando su FDR de señuelos -- el extremo superior del intervalo bootstrap de campos del 95 % con ``ci``, o la estimación en caso contrario; una parte sin ninguna llamada de señuelo se juzga como si tuviera tres -- es como máximo ``fdr_max``, y gana el ajuste que pasa con más llamadas reales. Si ninguno pasa, ``unreachable`` 'lowest_fdr' toma el ajuste con el FDR más bajo de ese tipo (y luego con más llamadas reales) y 'strictest' el último valor de cada eje; ``auto_met`` es entonces False. Con 'f_score' gana el ajuste con la F-score más alta de precisión (uno menos la estimación del FDR) y exhaustividad (la parte genotipada). Los empates se resuelven a favor del ajuste más estricto, y deciden en último lugar los ejes posteriores.

records.context: The decoys are :func:`spacr.ops_sbs.decoy_library` of every key of the whitelist, collision keys included, so each decoy lies at least two edits from every prefix. They join the whitelist as callable keys of gene :data:`DECOY_GENE` (level ``'decoy'``), so a read is matched against guides and decoys together and a read as close to a decoy as to a guide is ambiguous. Decoys have no one-base extension, so a Levenshtein indel never lands on one.
records.label: spacr.ops_prefix.prefix_decoy_library#1
records.source: The decoys are :func:`spacr.ops_sbs.decoy_library` of every key of the whitelist, collision keys included, so each decoy lies at least two edits from every prefix. They join the whitelist as callable keys of gene :data:`DECOY_GENE` (level ``'decoy'``), so a read is matched against guides and decoys together and a read as close to a decoy as to a guide is ambiguous. Decoys have no one-base extension, so a Levenshtein indel never lands on one.
records.translation: Los señuelos son :func:`spacr.ops_sbs.decoy_library` de cada clave de la lista blanca, incluidas las claves de colisión, de modo que cada señuelo queda al menos a dos ediciones de cada prefijo. Se unen a la lista blanca como claves invocables del gen :data:`DECOY_GENE` (nivel ``'decoy'``), de modo que una lectura se compara con guías y señuelos a la vez, y una lectura tan cercana a un señuelo como a una guía es ambigua. Los señuelos no tienen extensión de una base, por lo que un indel de Levenshtein nunca cae sobre uno.
